description: Agent-based, network-embedded simulation of mask adoption with social influence, policy enforcement, media/information campaigns, and supply/price constraints. Agents move through contexts (home, work/school, retail, transit), update beliefs via peers/media/policies, decide use with a stochastic utility model, and purchase masks subject to supply and budgets.

modules.name: SocialNetworkInfluence
modules.description: Generates and updates peer influence signals via the social network and updates individual attitudes/beliefs from peers.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  N_i = neighbors(i)
  if |N_i| > 0:
    observed_use = weighted_avg_over_j_in_Ni( Person[j].current_mask_use, tie_strength(i,j) )
    observed_att = weighted_avg_over_j_in_Ni( Person[j].mask_attitude, tie_strength(i,j) )
  else:
    observed_use = 0
    observed_att = 0
  peer_signal_i = social_influence_weight * (0.5*observed_use + 0.5*observed_att)
  Person[i].peer_signal = peer_signal_i
  # DeGroot-style update of attitude
  Person[i].mask_attitude = (1 - Person[i].social_influence_susceptibility) * Person[i].mask_attitude + Person[i].social_influence_susceptibility * observed_att
  # optional decay of weak ties
  tie_strength(i,j) = tie_strength(i,j) * (1 - tie_strength_decay) for all j
notes: peer_signal is a normalized [0,1] pressure term entering the mask use utility.
tie_strength_decay allows slowly weakening unused ties; set to 0 for static networks.
Homophily applied at network generation: similar age/risk nodes more likely to connect.

modules.name: MediaAndRiskSignal
modules.description: Broadcasts information about efficacy, norms, and risk; generates a daily risk signal and updates individual perceptions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
risk_raw_t = base_risk_signal + Normal(0, risk_signal_variability)
risk_signal_t = moving_average(risk_raw_t, window=risk_moving_average_window)
media_norm_signal = message_intensity * message_content_balance * media_credibility
for each person i:
  trust_weight = 0.5*media_credibility + 0.5*Person[i].trust_in_authorities
  Person[i].media_signal = media_influence_weight * media_norm_signal * trust_weight
  # Update risk perception toward risk_signal
  Person[i].risk_perception = clamp01( (1 - Person[i].health_signal_sensitivity)*Person[i].risk_perception + Person[i].health_signal_sensitivity * risk_signal_t )
  # Update efficacy belief toward message content
  Person[i].perceived_mask_efficacy = clamp01( (1 - efficacy_update_rate)*Person[i].perceived_mask_efficacy + efficacy_update_rate * message_content_balance )
notes: message_content_balance is fraction pro-mask content in [0,1].
If an epidemic module is used, replace risk_raw_t with normalized prevalence.

modules.name: PolicyAndLocationEnforcement
modules.description: Applies mandates and enforcement to locations, computes policy pressure and expected penalties.

notes: policy_pressure is an additive utility term in decision.
signage_effect increases effective enforcement without penalties.

modules.name: MobilityAndContacts
modules.description: Generates daily activity schedules and assigns people to locations, producing context exposure for mask decisions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  schedule = {home:1}
  schedule.work = Bernoulli(p_work_or_school)
  schedule.retail = Bernoulli(p_retail)
  schedule.transit = Bernoulli(p_transit)
  assign to specific locations with available capacity if schedule says visit
  Person[i].daily_activity_schedule = schedule
# Provide context modifiers for utility
context_modifier_home_signal = context_modifier_home
context_modifier_work_signal = context_modifier_work
context_modifier_retail_signal = context_modifier_retail
context_modifier_transit_signal = context_modifier_transit
notes: Capacities are soft constraints; if full, redirect or skip visit.
Context modifiers reflect norms/comfort in each context.

modules.name: SupplyChainMarket
modules.description: Maintains stock, fulfills demand with delays, and adjusts price given demand, elasticity, and subsidies.

update_rule.pseudocode:
# Restock
SupplyChain.stock_level += restock_rate_per_day
# Price adjustment using proportional control informed by elasticity
smoothed_demand = moving_average(demand_intent_today, window=demand_smoothing_window)
excess_demand_ratio = (smoothed_demand - restock_rate_per_day) / max(1, restock_rate_per_day)
price_tentative = SupplyChain.mask_price * (1 + price_adjustment_rate * excess_demand_ratio / max(0.1, abs(price_elasticity)))
price_after_subsidy = max(price_floor, min(price_ceiling, price_tentative - subsidy_level))
SupplyChain.mask_price = price_after_subsidy
signal.effective_price_to_consumer = SupplyChain.mask_price
# Fulfillment with distribution delay handled via order queue
fulfill_orders_due_today()
ensure SupplyChain.stock_level >= 0
if backorder_allowed == false and stock_level < 0: set stock_level=0; record lost sales
notes: Orders are queued and fulfilled after distribution_delay_days.
Subsidy is modeled as a direct per-mask price reduction.

modules.name: PurchaseAndInventory
modules.description: Determines when and how much each person purchases based on inventory target, price, and budgets.

update_rule.pseudocode:
total_demand_intent = 0
for each person i:
  if day % purchase_interval_days == 0:
    expected_use_days = inventory_target_days
    expected_daily_use = mask_use_rate_per_day * (Person[i].daily_activity_schedule.work + Person[i].daily_activity_schedule.retail + Person[i].daily_activity_schedule.transit)
    desired_qty = max(0, ceil(expected_daily_use * expected_use_days) - Person[i].mask_inventory)
    affordability = floor( (Person[i].budget * economic_constraint_scale) / signal.effective_price_to_consumer )
    order_qty = max(0, min(desired_qty, affordability))
    enqueue_purchase_order(i, order_qty)
    total_demand_intent += order_qty
signal.demand_intent_today = total_demand_intent
notes: Budget is refreshed weekly or kept constant per scenario.
If affordability is zero, agent does not order; unmet need can affect future attitudes.

modules.name: MaskUseDecision
modules.description: Computes context-specific mask-wearing probabilities and samples behavior; decrements inventory.

notes: Utility includes social, media, policy, risk*efficacy, context modifier, and discomfort.
Inventory is decremented per day of use; mask_use_rate_per_day can be fractional.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates adoption observables, computes metrics like time to threshold, sustained adoption, inequality indices.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adopt_overall = mean_over_i( mean_over_contexts(Person[i].current_mask_use[c]) )
adopt_home = mean_over_i(Person[i].current_mask_use['home']) if defined else 0
adopt_work = mean_over_i(Person[i].current_mask_use['work']) if defined else 0
adopt_retail = mean_over_i(Person[i].current_mask_use['retail']) if defined else 0
adopt_transit = mean_over_i(Person[i].current_mask_use['transit']) if defined else 0
observable.adoption_rate_daily.append(smooth(adopt_overall, window=adoption_curve_smoothing_window))
observable.adoption_rate_by_context = {home: adopt_home, work: adopt_work, retail: adopt_retail, transit: adopt_transit}
observable.mask_price_daily.append(SupplyChain.mask_price)
stockout = 1 if SupplyChain.stock_level <= 0 or SupplyChain.backorder_level > 0 else 0
observable.stockout_indicator_daily.append(stockout)
# Inequality index (Gini over age-group means)
age_groups = ['young','adult','senior']
means_by_group = [mean_over_i_in_group(g, mean_over_contexts(Person[i].current_mask_use)) for g in age_groups]
observable.inequality_index_age_daily.append(gini(means_by_group))
# person-days masked
increment person_days_masked_cum by sum_over_i(mean_over_contexts(Person[i].current_mask_use))
notes: Gini computed over group means, not individuals.

algorithms.PeerInfluence: DeGroot opinion averaging with weighted ties
algorithms.ChoiceModel: Logit (softmax) utility with temperature for context-specific mask use
algorithms.PriceUpdate: Proportional control informed by demand elasticity with subsidy offset
algorithms.OrderFulfillment: FIFO queue with fixed distribution delay
algorithms.MobilityScheduling: Bernoulli draws per context with capacity-aware assignment
algorithms.DifferenceInDifferences: Pre/post comparison of treated vs control contexts
algorithms.ElasticityEstimation: Log-log regression of adoption on price
